fit_domain: M=1.50..3.00 by 0.01, alpha=0 deg; each geometry weighted equally; multiplier 0..1 by .001; blend force and first moment, not CP positions
adoption: Require improvement over full finite wing on held-out default RASAero CP; neither NASA vehicle may worsen by more than 0.10 D CP RMS or 5 percent CNa RMS against full finite wing. Blind exports, alternate RAS options, Iris flights and angle challenges never enter the fit.
